entries.name: Kenney Game Assets
entries.en: Thousands of consistent 2D sprites, UI, 3D models and sound packs; great for prototypes and game jams.

entries.name: Quaternius
entries.en: Low-poly 3D packs (characters, nature, buildings, weapons) in FBX/OBJ/glTF; free packs are CC0.
entries.zh: 低多边形 3D 素材包（角色、自然、建筑、武器），FBX/OBJ/glTF 格式，免费包为 CC0。

entries.name: OpenGameArt.org
entries.license: Per asset (CC0 / CC-BY / CC-BY-SA / GPL / OGA-BY)
entries.en: Community library of 2D, 3D, music and SFX; each asset page states its license, so check before use.
entries.zh: 社区共享的 2D、3D、音乐和音效库；每个素材页都标明许可证，使用前逐个确认。

entries.name: KhronosGroup/glTF-Sample-Assets
entries.license: Per model (mostly CC0 / CC-BY-4.0; a few under custom terms, see REUSE.toml)
entries.en: Reference glTF models for testing loaders, PBR materials and engine import pipelines.
entries.zh: 官方 glTF 参考模型，适合测试加载器、PBR 材质和引擎导入流程。
entries.license_zh: 按模型单独授权（多为 CC0 / CC-BY-4.0，少数为自定义条款，见 REUSE.toml）

entries.license: Free low-poly meshes: CC-BY-4.0 or Polyfork licence (your choice); ES modules and HD editions: Polyfork licence only

entries.zh: 3000+ 个免费低多边形 3D 模型，GLB 加 three.js ES 模块；走 CC BY 要署名 Polyfork，走 Polyfork 许可不用署名但不能转发文件。付费档另有 HD 版。

entries.name: The Base Mesh
entries.en: 1,250+ real-world-scale base meshes for greyboxing, sculpting and prototyping.
entries.zh: 1250+ 个按真实尺寸做的基础网格，适合白盒搭场景、雕刻起稿和做原型。

entries.name: LiberatedPixelCup/Universal-LPC-Spritesheet-Character-Generator
entries.license: GPL-3.0 (code); art per asset (CC0 / CC-BY / CC-BY-SA / OGA-BY / GPL)

entries.en: Browser generator for layered RPG character spritesheets with walk, slash and cast animations; exports a credits file.
entries.zh: 网页版 RPG 角色精灵表生成器，分层拼装，含行走、劈砍、施法动画，可导出署名清单。

entries.name: makehumancommunity/makehuman
entries.en: Parametric 3D human character creator; exported characters and bundled assets are CC0.
entries.zh: 参数化 3D 人物角色生成器；导出的角色和自带素材为 CC0。

entries.name: vrm-c/UniVRM
entries.en: Unity importer/exporter for VRM humanoid avatars (glTF-based), with spring bones and expressions.
entries.zh: Unity 的 VRM 人形角色导入导出工具（基于 glTF），支持弹簧骨骼和表情。

entries.name: PolygonalMind/initiative-opensource-release
entries.en: CC0 releases from Polygonal Mind, including the 100 Avatars character packs and 3D environments.
entries.zh: Polygonal Mind 的 CC0 开源发布，含 100 Avatars 角色包和 3D 场景。

entries.name: Game-icons.net
entries.en: 4,000+ free SVG/PNG game icons (skills, items, status effects); credit each icon's author.
entries.zh: 4000+ 个 SVG/PNG 游戏图标（技能、道具、状态），按要求给每个图标作者署名。

entries.en: Button prompt icons for keyboard, mouse and common controllers, for tutorials and input hints.
entries.zh: 键盘、鼠标和常见手柄的按键提示图标，做新手引导和操作提示用。

entries.name: ocornut/imgui
entries.en: Immediate-mode GUI library (Dear ImGui) for debug menus, in-game tools and editors.

entries.name: Kenney UI Pack
entries.en: 430 UI elements (buttons, sliders, panels) in several colors for menus and HUDs.
entries.zh: 430 个 UI 元素（按钮、滑条、面板），多种配色，做菜单和 HUD。

entries.name: Poly Haven
entries.en: High-quality PBR textures, HDRIs and photoscanned models; ideal for realistic scenes and lighting.
entries.zh: 高质量 PBR 贴图、HDRI 环境光和扫描模型，适合写实场景和打光。

entries.name: ambientCG
entries.en: Large CC0 library of PBR materials, HDRIs and models with multiple resolutions.
entries.zh: 大量 CC0 PBR 材质、HDRI 和模型，提供多种分辨率。

entries.en: Generates normal, height, specular, AO, roughness and metallic maps from a single image (last updated 2023).

entries.name: armory3d/armorpaint
entries.en: 3D painting tool for PBR texturing of models (source; prebuilt binaries are sold separately).

entries.name: azagaya/laigter

entries.zh: 给 2D 精灵生成法线、高光和遮蔽贴图，实现动态光照。

entries.name: Freesound
entries.en: Huge community sound library; filter by license (CC0 or CC-BY for commercial games) and credit when required.
entries.zh: 超大社区音效库；按许可证筛选（商用游戏选 CC0 或 CC-BY），需要署名时照做。

entries.name: Sonniss #GameAudioGDC Bundles

entries.en: Yearly free bundles of professional SFX, royalty-free for commercial games.
entries.zh: 每年免费放出的专业音效合集，商用游戏免版税。
entries.license_zh: 免版税（Sonniss 许可：可商用，无需署名）

entries.name: chr15m/jsfxr

entries.name: raysan5/rfxgen
entries.en: Small sfxr-style sound effect generator from the raylib author; desktop and web.
entries.zh: raylib 作者做的小型 sfxr 风格音效生成器，桌面版和网页版都有。

entries.name: YuriSizov/boscaceoil-blue

entries.zh: 新手友好的步进音序器作曲工具，是 Terry Cavanagh 的 Bosca Ceoil 现代移植版，适合做游戏循环配乐和短旋律。

entries.name: mackron/miniaudio

entries.name: Tonejs/Tone.js

entries.name: goldfire/howler.js

entries.en: Retro sound effect generator (extended sfxr) for jumps, pickups and explosions.

entries.name: libgdx/libgdx
entries.en: Java game framework for desktop, Android, iOS and web.
entries.zh: Java 游戏框架，支持桌面、安卓、iOS 和网页。

entries.name: excaliburjs/Excalibur
entries.en: TypeScript 2D game engine for the web.
entries.zh: TypeScript 写的网页 2D 游戏引擎。

entries.name: pixijs/pixijs
entries.en: Fast 2D WebGL/WebGPU renderer for web games and interactive graphics.
entries.zh: 高速 2D WebGL/WebGPU 渲染器，做网页游戏和交互图形。

entries.name: playcanvas/engine
entries.en: WebGL/WebGPU 3D game engine (runtime) for the web.
entries.zh: 网页 WebGL/WebGPU 3D 游戏引擎（运行时）。

entries.name: kaplayjs/kaplay
entries.en: Beginner-friendly JavaScript game library (successor of Kaboom.js).
entries.zh: 新手友好的 JavaScript 游戏库（Kaboom.js 的继任者）。

entries.name: hajimehoshi/ebiten
entries.en: Ebitengine, a simple 2D game engine for Go.
entries.zh: Ebitengine，Go 语言的简单 2D 游戏引擎。

entries.name: FyroxEngine/Fyrox
entries.en: 3D and 2D game engine in Rust with a scene editor.
entries.zh: Rust 写的 3D/2D 游戏引擎，带场景编辑器。

entries.name: HeapsIO/heaps
entries.en: Cross-platform 2D/3D game engine for Haxe.
entries.zh: Haxe 语言的跨平台 2D/3D 游戏引擎。

entries.name: Blender
entries.en: Free 3D suite for modeling, rigging, animation and baking game assets; your output is yours.
entries.zh: 免费 3D 全家桶：建模、绑骨、动画、烘焙；做出来的作品归你。

link_note.en: official site returns 403 to automated checks; license verified manually
link_note.zh: 官网对自动检查返回 403，许可证已人工核实

entries.name: RodZill4/material-maker
entries.en: Node-based procedural texture and material authoring tool built on Godot.
entries.zh: 基于 Godot 的节点式程序化贴图 / 材质制作工具。

entries.name: Orama-Interactive/Pixelorama
entries.en: Pixel art editor for sprites, tiles and frame animation; runs on desktop and web.
entries.zh: 像素画编辑器，画精灵、图块和逐帧动画；桌面和网页都能用。

entries.name: mapeditor/tiled
entries.en: Flexible tile map / level editor; exports TMX/JSON used by most 2D engines.
entries.zh: 灵活的瓦片地图 / 关卡编辑器，导出的 TMX/JSON 被大多数 2D 引擎支持。

entries.name: deepnight/ldtk
entries.en: Modern, lightweight 2D level editor with auto-layer tiling and typed entity fields.
entries.zh: 现代轻量 2D 关卡编辑器，支持自动图层铺块和带类型的实体字段。

entries.name: audacity/audacity
entries.en: Audio editor for trimming, layering and cleaning up game sound effects.
entries.zh: 音频编辑器，剪切、叠加、降噪游戏音效。

entries.name: LMMS/lmms
entries.en: Free music production software (sequencer, synths, sampler) for game soundtracks and stingers.
entries.zh: 免费编曲软件（音序器、合成器、采样器），做游戏配乐和短提示音。

entries.name: godotengine/godot-demo-projects
entries.en: Official Godot demo and template projects (2D, 3D, physics, UI) to learn from or start with.
entries.zh: Godot 官方示例和模板项目（2D、3D、物理、UI），可以照着学或直接起步。

entries.name: KDE/krita
entries.en: Digital painting app for concept art, textures and hand-drawn animation.
entries.zh: 数字绘画软件，画概念图、贴图和手绘动画。

entries.name: LibreSprite/LibreSprite
entries.en: Free pixel-art and sprite animation editor (fork of the last GPL Aseprite).
entries.zh: 免费像素画和精灵动画编辑器（从最后一个 GPL 版 Aseprite 分叉）。

entries.name: odrick/free-tex-packer
entries.en: Free texture-atlas packer with exporters for Phaser, Pixi, Unity, Godot and more.
entries.zh: 免费图集打包工具，可导出 Phaser、Pixi、Unity、Godot 等格式。

entries.name: Ogmo-Editor-3/OgmoEditor3-CE
entries.en: Free, engine-agnostic 2D level editor with tiles, entities and decals (last updated 2024).
entries.zh: 免费、不绑引擎的 2D 关卡编辑器，支持图块、实体和贴花（最后更新 2024 年）。

entries.name: TrenchBroom/TrenchBroom
entries.en: Brush-based 3D level editor for Quake-style maps, usable with Godot via plugins.
entries.zh: Quake 风格的笔刷式 3D 关卡编辑器，可借插件用于 Godot。

entries.name: JannisX11/blockbench
entries.en: Low-poly and voxel-style 3D model editor with texturing and animation.
entries.zh: 低多边形 / 方块风 3D 模型编辑器，可画贴图、做动画。

entries.name: guillaumechereau/goxel
entries.en: Open-source voxel editor for 3D models and scenes.
entries.zh: 开源体素编辑器，做 3D 模型和场景。

entries.name: donmccurdy/glTF-Transform
entries.en: CLI and SDK to optimize glTF/GLB: compression, texture resize, deduplication.
entries.zh: 优化 glTF/GLB 的命令行和 SDK：压缩、缩贴图、去重。

entries.name: zeux/meshoptimizer
entries.en: Mesh optimization library and gltfpack tool for smaller, faster 3D assets.
entries.zh: 网格优化库和 gltfpack 工具，让 3D 资产更小更快。

entries.name: assimp/assimp
entries.en: Open Asset Import Library: loads 40+ 3D formats into one data structure.
entries.zh: 开放资产导入库：把 40 多种 3D 格式读成统一数据结构。

entries.name: microsoft/TRELLIS
entries.en: Image/text-to-3D model generation (meshes, radiance fields, Gaussians) from Microsoft.
entries.zh: 微软的图像 / 文本生成 3D 模型（网格、辐射场、高斯）。

entries.name: VAST-AI-Research/TripoSR
entries.en: Fast single-image to 3D mesh reconstruction model.
entries.zh: 单张图快速重建 3D 网格的模型。

entries.name: TencentARC/InstantMesh
entries.en: Single image to 3D mesh generation with multi-view diffusion.
entries.zh: 单张图生成 3D 网格，基于多视角扩散。

entries.name: Comfy-Org/ComfyUI
entries.en: Node-based UI for diffusion models to generate textures, sprites and concept art.
entries.zh: 扩散模型的节点式界面，生成贴图、精灵和概念图。

entries.name: facebookresearch/audiocraft
entries.en: Meta's audio generation library (MusicGen, AudioGen) for music and sound effects; weights are non-commercial.
entries.zh: Meta 的音频生成库（MusicGen、AudioGen），生成音乐和音效；权重仅限非商业。

entries.name: Tencent-Hunyuan/Hunyuan3D-2
entries.license: Tencent Hunyuan 3D 2.0 Community License (not valid in EU, UK, South Korea)
entries.license_zh: 腾讯混元 3D 2.0 社区许可（不适用于欧盟、英国、韩国）
entries.en: Text/image-to-3D generation with textured meshes; check the territory and usage limits in its license.
entries.zh: 文本 / 图像生成带贴图的 3D 网格；使用前看清许可里的地区和用途限制。

entries.name: gamedev-skills/awesome-gamedev-agent-skills
entries.en: Collection of game-dev skills and a router for AI coding agents.
entries.zh: 给 AI 编程 Agent 用的游戏开发 skill 合集和路由。

entries.name: ellisonleao/magictools
entries.en: Long-running list of game development resources: engines, art, audio, tools.
entries.zh: 老牌游戏开发资源清单：引擎、美术、音频、工具。

entries.name: Calinou/awesome-gamedev
entries.en: List of free software and free culture resources for making games.
entries.zh: 制作游戏用的自由软件和自由文化资源清单。

entries.name: madjin/awesome-cc0
entries.en: List of CC0 assets from across the web: models, textures, sound.
entries.zh: 全网 CC0 素材清单：模型、贴图、声音。

entries.name: FronkonGames/Awesome-Gamedev
entries.en: Curated list of game development resources: tools, tutorials, libraries.
entries.zh: 精选游戏开发资源：工具、教程、库。

entries.name: dawdle-deer/awesome-learn-gamedev
entries.en: Curated learning resources for game development.
entries.zh: 游戏开发学习资源精选。

entries.name: Calinou/awesome-godot
entries.en: Curated list of Godot plugins, scripts, templates and projects.
entries.zh: Godot 插件、脚本、模板和项目精选清单。

entries.name: munificent/game-programming-patterns
entries.en: Source of the free online book Game Programming Patterns (design patterns for game code).
entries.zh: 免费在线书《游戏编程模式》的源码（游戏代码设计模式）。
